svg.title: LangGraph multimodal RAG pipeline
svg.desc: Shows the full LangGraph pipeline from user query through routing, retrieval, reranking, generation to final answer

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the user input node do in the LangGraph RAG pipeline? ↗')
sendPrompt('How does the query router node work in the LangGraph RAG pipeline? ↗')
g.text: text query → text path | image → image path

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the text retriever node work in the LangGraph RAG pipeline? ↗')
sendPrompt('How does the image retriever node work in the LangGraph RAG pipeline? ↗')
sendPrompt('How does the reranker node work in the LangGraph RAG pipeline? ↗')
sendPrompt('How does the context builder node work in the LangGraph RAG pipeline? ↗')
g.text: format chunks + attach figure image paths

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the generator node work in the LangGraph RAG pipeline? ↗')
g.text: LLM generates grounded answer with citations

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the final output of the LangGraph RAG pipeline look like? ↗')
g.text: text answer + cited chunks + figures shown
